CarDS Lab Presentation
TRACE-ECG: AI-ECG representations for confounding control in target trial emulation
Lab meeting, Thursday 15 October 2026
Results are provisional: the trial set is not frozen and the methods are not yet locked

Does X cause Y?

Ceteris paribus: all other things being equal

But RCTs are

  1. Costly
  2. Slow
  3. Often exclude multimorbid and underrepresented patients

What is propensity score matching?

  • Propensity scores (PS) balance only what is measured.
  • Claims record diagnoses, procedures and prescriptions consistently.
  • EHR labs, vital signs and imaging are missing for many patients, and not at random.
  • Many cardiovascular determinants of treatment and prognosis are physiological.

12-lead ECG as a substrate for cardiac physiology

  • Inexpensive and recorded routinely, for most patients.
  • AI-ECG detects LV dysfunction, structural heart disease and other latent phenotypes.
  • Foundation-model embeddings: general-purpose representations of cardiac physiology.

Question: can an ECG embedding capture confounding that structured data miss?

Adding the ECG embedding to the propensity score:

  1. Balance: improves balance on clinical, laboratory and echocardiographic characteristics not in the PS; a permuted-ECG placebo does not.
  2. Agreement with RCT results: moves emulated hazard ratios toward each trial's own RCT result, beyond generic attenuation.
  3. Bias removal against a known truth (plasmode): removes part of the bias from a hidden physiological confounder, in proportion to how well the ECG encodes it.

38 target trial emulations in Yale New Haven Health System EHR data

New-user, active-comparator designs; index dates 2011–2024; outcome = the trial's primary endpoint.

Emulation quality: framework v2.0 (next slides).

  • Scope: the paper is ECG-only. CLMBR-T was tested and dropped for clarity: with equal-information inputs it did not beat hdPS or PS-Flags. UK Biobank is out of scope.
  • Primary analysis: PS-CVD5 + ECG vs PS-CVD5 (was PS-Demo). Fixed L2 penalty C = 1 for every PS, 1:1 matching with caliper 0.2. A cross-validated penalty is a sensitivity analysis only, because it also shrinks the base covariates.
  • Leakage audit. Echo EF duplicates LVEF, eGFR is derived from creatinine, and the hdPS codes include the drug codes behind the medications item. So the primary panel is now 54 non-coded held-out items with leakage-corrected masking; the 58-item panel is secondary.
  • PS-Clinical has no LVEF (no PS contains any echo measurement) and uses 5-draw multiple imputation. Ladder: PS-Demo → PS-CVD5 → PS-CVD10 → hdPS → PS-Clinical (no LVEF). PS-Flags is supplement only.
  • Blind data check of the cohort definitions → spec-v2 cohort fixes: entry bounds, age, washouts, gates and 3 outcome rebuilds. Median 15% of patients removed per trial (range 0 to 60.2%). PCs are recomputed within the fixed cohorts.
  • Emulation-quality framework v2.0: 10 items scored in points, two independent raters, adjudication and an independent audit, then rescored on the fixed cohorts. This gives a 30-trial analysed set (provisional, not frozen).
  • R2 restart (now on branch r2): with a CV-tuned PS, PS-CVD5 + ECG fell to 4.7% (not supported). Most of the drop came from the CV penalty (8.6% at C = 1). We reverted to version 1, audited it, and then hardened it as above.

Tiers (first rule that matches)

LimitedTotal ≥ 8; or N2 ≥ 2; or PP and (total − CO) ≥ 3; or SI = 2 because of an arm-assignment or time-zero error (until rebuilt and re-scored)
ModerateTotal 5–7; or N2 = 1 (any single item at 2 caps the tier at Moderate, whatever the total)

ExcellentTotal 0–2, with no item at 2

Analysed set = Excellent + Good + Moderate. Rescored on the spec-v2 cohorts: defects that the fixes removed are no longer penalised. An entry bound that the data can apply, and that spec v2 applies, scores 0. Tiers: 5 / 7 / 18 / 8.

Process and agreement

  • Two independent raters, blind to results, scored the trials from protocols, spec, code and data checks
  • Adjudication, then an independent audit (2 blocking findings: inconsistent unscored deviations; freeze conditions not met)
  • Rescored on the fixed cohorts; scores were hashed before any impact number was computed

Five kinds of fix (patients removed; no index date moves)

  1. Published numeric entry bounds: HbA1c, BP, natriuretic peptides, cholesterol, renal and other labs; "unknown passes"
  2. Age bounds checked in all 38 (only CAROLINA removed anyone)
  3. Class washouts: other GLP-1RA, other SGLT2i, saxagliptin/alogliptin, prior ARNI, metoprolol succinate
  4. Gate fixes: LAAOS III AF before admission; LIFE definite LVH; COMET LVEF ≤35%; VALIANT LV dysfunction or HF
  5. Outcome rebuilds: AMPLIFY, LODESTAR, PROVE IT

Removing the same numbers of patients at random shrinks the gain just as much. So the drop from about 9% to 6.5% reflects refitting on smaller cohorts, not the fixes as such.

Not fixed (they need full rebuilds): CABANA (arm assignment) and TRANSFORM-HF (time zero); both stay scored. Six trials lost nobody.

No PS contains any echocardiographic measurement. PS-Clinical without LVEF was re-imputed without LVEF, with 5 draws: per-item |SMD| is averaged across draws and HRs are combined by Rubin's rules.

ECG representation

BCL self-supervised signal encoder, 256-d → 32 PCs computed within each (fixed) cohort. Latest 12-lead ECG in [index − 365 d, index], index day included (37% of ECGs, version 1 cohorts; disclosed per trial).

Placebo

Permuted ECG: the embeddings are shuffled between patients within each trial, so the dimension is the same and the information is gone.

PS and matching

L2-penalised logistic PS on standardised covariates, fixed C = 1 for every specification. 1:1 greedy nearest-neighbour matching on the PS logit, caliper 0.2 SD, without replacement. Sensitivities: caliper 0.1, 1:3 matching, IPTW, overlap weights, gradient-boosted PS. A cell with <11 matched pairs counts as failed.

Rules: mask any held-out item that is the same quantity as, derived from, or in the same code family as a PS input, or has pooled |ρ| ≥ 0.80 with one. Soft proxies (0.50 ≤ |ρ| < 0.80, e.g. BUN, LVESVi, GLS) stay in. Items that are PS inputs are always masked.

Endpoints and tests

  • Primary: relative reduction in mean |SMD| after matching = 1 − (mean over trials with the ECG / without it); 95% CI from 4,000 bootstrap resamples of trials
  • Items are used only where they are observed in both compared cells
  • Secondary endpoints: % of items with |SMD| < 0.1; trials improved; per-domain reductions
  • Exact sign-flip permutation across trials (one-sided vs base or placebo); BH-FDR within families
  • Agreement (secondary): Cox model in the matched cohort, pair-clustered; |Δ log HR| vs the RCT; benchmark-permutation test (RCT results reassigned across trials, 20,000 draws) required for any agreement claim

  • Real covariates, ECGs and follow-up; treatment simulated from the hidden confounder C (LVEF, NT-proBNP, BMI or eGFR; clinically oriented); true HR 0.80; 107 trial × C cells, 50 replicates each
  • C is in no PS except the oracle (93.7% removed)
  • The ECG removes a further 11.3% of the bias that PS-CVD5 leaves (LVEF 15.2% · NT-proBNP 15.1% · BMI 19.2% · eGFR 2.5%)
  • 95% CI coverage: unmatched 51.2%, PS-CVD5 64.8%, PS-CVD5 + ECG 69.2%, oracle 94.4%. No representation substitutes for measuring C
PS-CVD5 analog + ECG + permuted ECG

7 cardiovascular trials + PEPTIC (negative control). PS-CVD5 analog = demographics + HTN, T2D, CAD, AF, HF from earlier admissions. 26 held-out labs, vitals, ventilation and utilisation items (no echo).

Bootstrap CI: 2,000 resamples (seed 0, the v20 convention). The estimate moves by about ±5 points between near-identical specifications.

  1. The ECG improves held-out balance when the PS is thin, i.e. demographics and a few diagnoses: PS-CVD5 + ECG 5.5% (0.8 to 10.7) on the 30 analysed trials (PS-Demo + ECG 9.8%). It is consistently better than its permuted placebo.
  2. The gain shrinks or vanishes with code-rich or measured covariates: hdPS + ECG −0.2%; PS-Clinical (no LVEF) + ECG 4.5%, concentrated in observed LVEF and echo structure.
  3. No trial-specific agreement with the RCTs. |Δ log HR| does not improve, and the benchmark-permutation P is ≥ .95 in every trial set. (CVD10 + ECG gave P = .001 on the 30: post hoc, exploratory only.)
  4. Supporting: the plasmode (the ECG removes part of a hidden physiological confounder's bias beyond PS-CVD5) and MIMIC-IV (similar balance gain, no agreement gain).
  5. Caveats: one health system; a provisional, unfrozen trial set rated by LLM runs (clinician review pending); a post hoc switch of the primary to PS-CVD5; effect sizes of a few points move with design details.
  1. Freeze the trial set (framework §7.6): hash or commit the rater files; run DC-ES-cross, DC-EL-met and DC-SI-hf-anyposition; transcribe the S5 publication facts; complete the clinician review. Then switch the default to the frozen set.
  2. TRANSFORM-HF: keep it at Moderate (documented time-zero error, TZ = 2), or treat a data-confirmed TZ = 2 as Limited? It needs a rebuild either way.
  3. Hypertension switch trials (ALLHAT, ASCOT-BPLA, VALUE; ONTARGET through TZ.b): Moderate as written, or a "TZ.c ≥50% + ≥3 other points → Limited" rule (27 trials)?
  4. B1, second half: the TECOS and CARMELINA sulfonylurea-background subgroups and the TECOS background-therapy requirement. One EL point makes either trial Limited.
  5. Clarifications C1–C10, especially C1 (EL vs SI for undocumented code-defined criteria) and C3 (any-position I50).
  1. hdPS and PS-Flags on the smaller fixed cohorts: likely artefacts (within-cohort ≥1% filter, fixed C = 1). Run the sensitivity with the version 1 flag columns.
  2. Cohort fixes as primary (pipeline.md §2 and §10.2 still PENDING); MI imputation population (fixed cohort vs roster).
  3. OU re-score for LODESTAR and PROVE IT (Excellent + Good: 12 vs 10); entry bounds applied with "unknown passes".
  4. Title (the "Multimodal" working title no longer fits) and the manuscript file (paper.md vs paper2.md).
  5. Clinician review of the quality adjudication and the physiologic trial labels; confirm the CLMBR-T removal with the PI.
